name: Perplexity Pro

price.note: $17 a month billed annually. Monthly billing is reported at $20 (third-party report, unconfirmed). Education Pro is $10 a month with SheerID verification.

meters.label: Pro Searches
meters.hint: Weekly, sized for "average use". Settings → Usage

reset.rule: A weekly limit. Perplexity doesn't publish the count or the reset day.
stipulations: Advanced-model access may be limited during weeks of especially heavy usage.
File uploads have a separate weekly limit.

reset.rule: Recovers gradually on a rolling basis. A billing date or renewal doesn't reset it, and no exact reset time is shown.
stipulations: Perplexity doesn't publish the count for consumer plans. For scale, Enterprise Pro gets 50 a month.

reset.rule: A monthly limit. Perplexity doesn't publish the count or the reset day.
stipulations: Comet in Work mode spends Computer credits. Comet in Search mode doesn't.

reset.rule: Resets every 30 days. Perplexity doesn't say from which date.

meters.label: Computer allowance
meters.hint: "Included in Pro" on the Usage page

reset.rule: A weekly allowance that starts at your first use and doesn't roll over.
stipulations: Credits are spent in this order: weekly included usage, then bonus, then monthly, then purchased.
100 credits = $1. Auto-refill is off by default.
Purchased credits expire after a year of not using Computer.
This weekly allowance is still rolling out to accounts gradually.

overage: Searches and Research pause at their limits until they recover. Computer can continue on bought credits, with auto-refill at 500 credits if you turn it on. The Pro spend cap is fixed and can't be raised.

how: Weekly Pro Searches, plus monthly Research, Browser Agent and Create limits, sized for average use. No counts are published.
A weekly Computer credit allowance. New subscribers get 4,000 bonus credits that expire in about 30 days.
Enhanced image generation and limited video.
ext: Models from other companies: GPT-6.2 Sol, Gemini 4 Neon, Claude Sonnet 5.5 (with Thinking), Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, GLM 5.3 and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL.
These models work inside Perplexity on the web only, not through the API. Computer has its own model list.
quirks: Accounts on a promo code get lower limits. Perplexity confirmed this on 19 May 2026.
Free or fully discounted promo plans usually get no bonus credits.
The pricing page says "unlimited Pro Searches" but the plan table lists a weekly limit.
Users report advanced-model limits of about 100 to 150 queries a week since May 2026 (third-party report, unconfirmed).
The old $5 monthly API credit is gone. An older help article still lists it.
Upgrading to Max on mobile after subscribing on the web creates a second, separate subscription.
